The verdict is **fix**: the work meets all the asks I could check, but the new [Cleaner page](/framework/ext/Refine/cleaner/) has an unreadable first row in its "live instance" tree. The labels "data", "object" and the value draw on top of each other at both 400 and 1920 wide.

The report is at `refine-audit/review/report.md`, with three smaller notes:
- The Refine page is still 2.3 screens tall on a phone. That is the state before this change, and the redesign proposal addresses it but isn't built yet.
- The instant clean still merges "Can you hear me" into the next sentence. The audit already names this and leaves it unfixed, which is fair.
- I couldn't check the progress cards on `/live/` or the message to the voice mastermind, because neither leaves anything in the diff.
